body: The project README says the project is licensed under the "creative commons v3.0 license". There are a whole set of licenses produced by Creative Commons that have a v3.0, and they have **very** different rights and obligations between them. The specific license applicable should be specified.

comments.body: (This is purely editorial in impact - it changes nothing but the ease of understanding what people can do with the project's content)

Thanks for the suggestion and I agree we should be more exact. Please open a different PR targeting this to the master branch instead as 4.0.3 should now be static. Maybe also consider if it is necessary to make this change anywhere else in the standard itself within the 5.0 folder, thanks :)

Made #1243 for README in the master branch

I'll look at the 5.0 branch now...

In the 5.0 folder, [Frontispiece.md](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x01-Frontispiece.md) accurately declares the specific license.

I note that Creative Commons now offers the license in version 4.0 (rather than the 3.0 that currently applies). But changing the license seems like a separate issue, and a decision for the project to take rather than an outsider  like me.

I believe this issue is ready to close by merging #1243
